content.title: Justin Bieber Shares a ‘Little Sneak Preview’ of Coachella Performance
content.text: Skip to main content Justin Bieber Shares a ‘Little Sneak Preview’ of Coachella Performance The star posted a clip from his secret Roxy Theater performance ahead of the festival Justin Bieber Christopher Polk/Billboard/Getty Images Justin Bieber is prepping fans for his headlining Coachella set next week. On Tuesday, the pop star shared a montage clip on X from his secret pre-Coachella show at the Roxy Theater in Los Angeles this past weekend. Bieber performed his first U.S. concert in four years on Sunday night at an invite-only gig with a no-phones policy. The new clip provides fans who couldn’t be there a taste of what’s to come. In the clip, Bieber tells the Roxy Theater audience, “I just want to say thank you so much for coming tonight. This is so beautiful, it’s a little sneak preview into Coachella, which is going to be so much fun.” The clip also includes shots of the singer performing in a pink beanie and a TLC t-shirt at one point, and entirely shirtless at another. He’s seen cycling through Swag songs “Daisies,” “Speed Demon,” “Walking Away,” “Go Baby Go,” and “Yukon.” Bieber delivered a 25-song set on Sunday. Notably, the pop star only sang tracks from his two 2025 albums, Swag and Swag II (per Setlist.fm and a photo shared on social media). If the show and its accompanying setlist are a “sneak peek” into Bieber’s Coachella set, it could indicate that hits from the previous years, like 2021’s “Peaches” or 2010’s career-setting “Baby,” will not be performed. Trending Stories The private club gig also featured three separate sets, according to Setlist.fm, with two “regular” ones divided by an “acoustic set” in the middle of the performance. During the acoustic section, Bieber delivered tracks like “Mother in You,” “Things You Do,” and “Dotted Line.” Whatever he may have up his sleeve, Bieber’s Coachella performance is one of the most-anticipated sets from the festival. Prior to Sunday night’s invite-only event, the singer hadn’t performed a full-fledged public concert since his Justice tour ended in 2022. There have been a few scattered private performances, and Bieber did perform at the Grammys 2026, but Coachella will mark his big return to a major stage for a set longer than a couple of songs.
